newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank savings at 3.792 trillion yuan end-Nov.
newsitem.headline: China bank savings at 3.792 trillion yuan end-Nov.

text.p: Personal savings in China's banking system reached 3.792 trillion yuan ($456.75 billion) at the end of November, up 31.5 percent from the beginning of the year, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
An easing of inflation had meant savings deposits were still the favoured means of investment for Chinese people despite cuts in bank deposit rates in May and August, Xinhua said.

Interest paid on one-year personal deposits had fallen to 7.47 percent from 10.98 percent before the first of the interest rate cuts in May. But inflation over the first 11 months of this year was at 6.2 percent compared with 14.8 percent for all of last year, the agency said. It gave no further details.
